args: $repo=(Get-Location).Path; $tools=Join-Path (Split-Path $repo -Parent) '.espressif'; $idf=@(Get-ChildItem -Path $tools -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'esp-idf' } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }) | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $idf) { Write-Error "ESP-IDF not found under $tools"; return }; $env:IDF_TOOLS_PATH=$tools; $env:IDF_PATH=$idf; . (Join-Path $idf 'export.ps1'); $env:IDF_CCACHE_ENABLE='0'
